name: Modern Day
author: OpenDoctrines
description: Present-day world, 185 countries. Population from World Bank totals, resource deposits from USGS surveys and project-authored oil regions, territorial claims, diplomatic relations and ethnic composition.

name: The Powder Keg
author: OpenDoctrines
description: Five empires and a continent of alliances waiting on one funeral in Sarajevo. Nobody on this map has fought a European war in forty-three years.

name: The Last Spring
author: OpenDoctrines
description: Germany has won in the east and is losing in the west. Four empires have months to live and none of them knows which four.

name: Mitteleuropa
author: OpenDoctrines
description: Eighteen years after the armistice at Spa. Germany holds central Europe through a ring of client kingdoms it wrote the borders of, Austria-Hungary has survived its own succession, and the Entente lost. None of it is settled -- and in the steppe, the forests and the hills there are people who never stopped shooting at it.

name: The Gathering Storm
author: OpenDoctrines
description: Europe on the morning the Wehrmacht crossed the Polish border. Six empires still hold most of the world; the Soviet Union and Germany have just divided the ground between them.

name: Year Zero
author: OpenDoctrines
description: The war is over and nothing has been settled. Two powers are left standing, Europe is administered by soldiers, and every empire on this map is about to be asked to leave.

name: The Missile Crisis
author: OpenDoctrines
description: Two blocs, one ocean between them, and missiles in Cuba. Africa is coming out from under Europe faster than anyone planned, and the Sino-Soviet split is a year old.

name: The Long Occupation
author: OpenDoctrines
description: Twenty years under an occupation that was supposed to be permanent. You are not it. You are a government that got out, a command that never surrendered -- or a partisan republic holding a stretch of mountain the occupation has failed to take back, which is where this war is actually fought.

name: The Three Superstates
author: OpenDoctrines
description: Three powers divide the world and none of them can conquer another. The war is real, permanent, and fought over the belt of contested countries between them -- for their labour, and because a war that cannot be won need never end. Inspired by George Orwell's Nineteen Eighty-Four.

name: Mars
author: OpenDoctrines
description: Real Martian topography with the basins flooded. Every sea is a named basin -- Hellas, Utopia, Chryse, Argyre -- and every state stands on the highlands between them.
